Free day — nothing planned
Morning: last load of laundry

items.title: Laundry
items.note: Last wash; clothes will be fully dry before tomorrow's departure.

items.title: Pack and sleep early
items.note: Departure for the airport at 05:00 tomorrow. A breakfast box can be requested from reception, and tomorrow's car should be booked in advance.
items.tip: Passports, power banks and daily medicines go in the carry-on; checked bags should be closed up the night before.
